failure_patterns.pattern: wrong_domain_or_old_constraint_refiltered: Agent filtered the domain that happened to be cached (re-passing type=['Touristy'] or cuisine=['vegan']) instead of doing a pure retrieval ('Not really'), a seek_information (hotel reply, no dates), or a first search (date range after flights and a hotel were requested). It also filtered hotels when the reply was a restaurant dietary need combined with 'hotel near restaurants'.

rejected_edits.content: Write one three-line group (load, filter, save) per key that must be refined: a flight class/airline/time/price reply needs one group per flight leg, and a message that names two domains needs one group per domain. Each group is:

Hotel 'a 3.5 rating' -> rating=[3.5, 3.5]. A restaurant rating ('something with a 3.5 star rating', 'a 3.5 rating', 'at least / minimum 3.5') is a floor -> rating=[3.5, 5]. Never pass a one-element list.
rejected_edits.target: 'a 3.5 rating' -> rating=[3.5, 3.5]. 'at least / minimum 3.5' -> rating=[3.5, 5]. Never pass a one-element list.
